usage: wtune tune [-h] [--config CONFIG] [--site SITE] [--minutes MINUTES] [--nodes NODES]
                  [--node-objective {time,cost,knee}] [--deadline-minutes DEADLINE_MINUTES]
                  [--min-efficiency MIN_EFFICIENCY] [--sweep-budget-frac SWEEP_BUDGET_FRAC]
                  [--proxy {on,off}] [--proxy-max-nodes PROXY_MAX_NODES] [--hotspot-fill {on,off}]
                  [--node-seeds {geometric,all}] [--cores-per-node-options CORES_PER_NODE_OPTIONS]
                  [--pipeline {full}] [--max-queue-hours MAX_QUEUE_HOURS] [--no-space-check]
                  [--no-node-preflight] [-O0] [-O1] [-O2] [-O3] [--precision PRECISION]
                  [--level {0,1,2,3}] [--stop-if-short] [--physics-advice] [--keep-frames]
                  [--physics-max-candidates PHYSICS_MAX_CANDIDATES]
                  [--node-finalists NODE_FINALISTS] [--nodes-policy {cap,knee,min}]
                  [--max-nodes MAX_NODES] [--out OUT] [--project PROJECT] [--steps STEPS]
                  [--confirm-reps CONFIRM_REPS] [--restart-io-form {14,2}]
                  [--max-points MAX_POINTS] [--points-by {time,cost-indicators}] [--seed SEED]
                  [--kappa KAPPA] [--cores-per-node CORES_PER_NODE] [--hardware-id HARDWARE_ID]
                  [--env-source ENV_SOURCE] [--sbatch-script SBATCH_SCRIPT]
                  [--ledger-dir LEDGER_DIR] [--sacct-cmd SACCT_CMD]
                  [--poll-interval POLL_INTERVAL]
                  [case]

positional arguments:
  case                  registered campaign/cases.json case id; required here or via --config's
                        'case' key

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --config CONFIG       wtune config YAML file: search-space restrictions +
                        budget/probe/prediction defaults (wtune/config.py); CLI flags given
                        explicitly still override it, which overrides this module's own built-in
                        defaults
  --site SITE           campaign/sites/<site>.sh (default: the machine's, built-in scc)
  --minutes MINUTES     required here or via --config's budget.minutes
  --nodes NODES         N = fixed node count; 'search' (DEFAULT) = measure the ANCHOR at each
                        legal node count, choose N by --node-objective, then tune at the finalist
                        N; 'auto' = uncalibrated efficiency proxy (--nodes-policy), no
                        measurement. (a --config budget.nodes also overrides the default)
  --node-objective {time,cost,knee}
                        --nodes search: time = fastest (smallest N within noise), cost = fewest
                        node-hours (within --deadline-minutes), knee = largest N with efficiency
                        >= --min-efficiency (default: time)
  --deadline-minutes DEADLINE_MINUTES
                        --node-objective cost: whole-run wall-time limit (minutes)
  --min-efficiency MIN_EFFICIENCY
                        --node-objective knee: efficiency threshold (default 0.70)
  --sweep-budget-frac SWEEP_BUDGET_FRAC
                        --nodes search: share of --minutes the node sweep may use; once spent,
                        larger N are skipped ('sweep budget cap') so the finalists keep budget
                        (default 0.4, or --config's budget.sweep_budget_frac)
  --proxy {on,off}      small-domain proxy (`wtune proxy`; a nested case per domain). -O1/-O2: the
                        joint (N, layout) search times every legal N's layouts on one node each,
                        re-times the leaders as 3-node bands (N > 3) or the whole domain (N <= 3)
                        and picks (N, layout) from those scores with no real N-node probe; proxy
                        jobs may hold up to 4 x --max-nodes nodes at once. --nodes N: round0 sends
                        only the proxy's picks to real probes. Needs netCDF wrfinput/wrfbdy, else
                        the real search runs (default on, or --config's budget.proxy)
  --proxy-max-nodes PROXY_MAX_NODES
                        nodes the proxy jobs may hold at once (default 4 x --max-nodes, or
                        --config's budget.proxy_max_nodes); the tune takes longer when lower
  --hotspot-fill {on,off}
                        --nodes search: measure untried N near the best one in the nodes a sweep
                        wave leaves idle, when no longer than the wave (default on, or --config's
                        budget.hotspot_fill)
  --node-seeds {geometric,all}
                        --nodes search: 'geometric' (DEFAULT) = 1, 2, 4, ... and max_nodes, early
                        stop upward, then refine; 'all' = every legal N, no early stop (or
                        --config's budget.node_seeds)
  --cores-per-node-options CORES_PER_NODE_OPTIONS
                        --nodes search: comma list of cores per node to measure at the finalist
                        node counts (the rest of the node idles). Default derived from the
                        hardware core count C: C, C-2, round(C*8/9), round(C*2/3), C/2 (72 ->
                        72,70,64,48,36); layouts that are not legal are skipped. '--cores-per-
                        node-options 72' disables the dimension
  --pipeline {full}     full = -O3 (kept for compatibility): one pass -- layout search (node,
                        cores/node, ranks, threads, decomposition, tiles), whole-run prediction
                        from rebuilt points, physics advice (decision 0059)
  --max-queue-hours MAX_QUEUE_HOURS
                        --pipeline full: safety cap on the accumulated queue-only wait (hours,
                        default 6); queue wait is not charged to --minutes, but past this the run
                        stops and reports
  --no-space-check      submit even when converting the inputs to BP does not fit the space
                        writable at the BP cache (GPFS quota or free space)
  --no-node-preflight   skip the node health pre-flight (sinfo states + one 1-minute srun probe
                        per node checking $HOME, the case dir, wtune-src and wrf.exe); by default
                        failing nodes are excluded from every sbatch and max_nodes is capped at
                        the healthy node count
  -O0                   effort level 0: no jobs: cold-start predict + proxy layout (layout search
                        effort + physics advice; the prediction points come from the case type)
  -O1                   effort level 1: joint (N, layout) proxy search, one leader per N re-timed
                        (without the proxy: one t0 wave over N in {1,2,4,8,max healthy}) (layout
                        search effort + physics advice; the prediction points come from the case
                        type)
  -O2                   effort level 2: joint (N, layout) proxy search over every legal N, no real
                        N-node probe (the real node sweep when the proxy cannot run) (layout
                        search effort + physics advice; the prediction points come from the case
                        type)
  -O3                   effort level 3: full layout search: every legal N (coarse-to-fine),
                        cores/node, ranks x omp, nx x ny, numtiles at the finalists + confirm reps
                        (layout search effort + physics advice; the prediction points come from
                        the case type)
  --precision PRECISION
                        whole-run wall time needed to +-N% of the run (e.g. 10%) or +-MIN minutes
                        (e.g. 15); default 10%, at least 2 min: the case type decides how many
                        prediction points that takes (wtune.cost_drivers.plan_points_for_case)
  --level {0,1,2,3}     same as -O<level>; selects the one-pass pipeline (default level when only
                        --pipeline full is given: 3). The estimated tuning time of every level is
                        printed before anything runs; --minutes is an optional hard cap
  --stop-if-short       -O levels: when the whole run is shorter than the estimated tuning time,
                        step down to the highest level whose estimate fits (never below O1). OFF
                        by default: the layout search is not cut short
  --physics-advice      -O3: also run phase 3, the physics advice (opt-in, not part of the default
                        run)
  --keep-frames         --pipeline full: keep the phase-2/3 window-frame .nc files after the
                        fidelity gate (default: delete them, keeping the gate json/csv)
  --physics-max-candidates PHYSICS_MAX_CANDIDATES
                        --pipeline full: physics candidates tried in phase 3 (default 3)
  --node-finalists NODE_FINALISTS
                        --nodes search: how many node counts get the full round0/adaptive/confirm
                        search (default 2)
  --nodes-policy {cap,knee,min}
                        how --nodes auto picks a node count from the (uncalibrated) profile:
                        min=smallest legal, cap=largest legal within --max-nodes, knee=stop
                        doubling once marginal speedup drops below 1.5x (default: 'knee', or
                        --config's budget.nodes_policy)
  --max-nodes MAX_NODES
                        default: 13 (or --config's budget.max_nodes)
  --out OUT
  --project PROJECT     project dir (decision 0058): when given (or via $WTUNE_PROJECT / a
                        project.yaml above cwd) and --out is not, defaults --out to
                        <project>/tune/<id>/ instead of $HOME/wtune-runs/tune/<case>. Does not
                        otherwise change this command's behaviour.
  --steps STEPS         default: 20 (or --config's probe.steps)
  --confirm-reps CONFIRM_REPS
                        default: 2 (or --config's probe.confirm_reps)
  --restart-io-form {14,2}
                        io_form of the point jobs' shared restart (RANKING_RESTART_IO_FORM);
                        default 14 (ADIOS2), or --config's probe.restart_io_form
  --max-points MAX_POINTS
                        probe.max_points override
  --points-by {time,cost-indicators}
                        probe.points_by override (decision 0060): place the prediction points by
                        sun/time (default) or by a weather cost proxy (wtune.cost_drivers; sources
                        from probe.indicator_sources)
  --seed SEED
  --kappa KAPPA
  --cores-per-node CORES_PER_NODE
  --hardware-id HARDWARE_ID
  --env-source ENV_SOURCE
  --sbatch-script SBATCH_SCRIPT
  --ledger-dir LEDGER_DIR
                        where the probes write their ledger CSVs and run directories (default:
                        <project>/probes in a project, else $WTUNE_CAMPAIGN_OUT or $HOME/wtune-
                        runs/campaign)
  --sacct-cmd SACCT_CMD
  --poll-interval POLL_INTERVAL
